ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER E

Letter E — Elephant.

The letter E arrives with a purple elephant already beside it — big E, little e and one of the biggest, gentlest animals your child can name.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does E say?

“e — eh, like elephant”

E says eh, like the start of elephant — a short, open sound. E is the busiest letter in the alphabet, and this short eh is the sound to meet first.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace E e together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase E

Start at 1 at the top left, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top, slide across. Lift. Pull straight across the middle. Lift. Slide across the bottom.

Trace the lowercase e

One stroke. Start at 1 in the middle, slide across to the right, then curve up over the top, round to the left, down and round the bottom.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Elephant walk.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Swing one arm in front of your nose like a trunk and stomp around: eh, eh, elephant!

  2. 02

    Pick up three toys with your trunk and put them in a basket.

  3. 03

    Curl up small like a sleeping elephant when the walk is done.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
